english_text: We all are aware of the various types of terrorism that have been used by Spanish governments since 1975 . This failure to mention State terrorism , even in its general considerations , is most regrettable . We all know perfectly well too , that anti-terrorist legislation such as proposed by these means do not guarantee a fair trial all over the EU . We are aware that in the Kingdom of Spain this very year of 2001 , the Spanish government has pardoned torturers , released high officials already condemned on grounds of waging a ` dirty war ' and tolerates torture in the most despicable ways , until this very moment .
